name: mechacut
description: Skills-only package (Agent Plugins v1): teaches agents the mechacut.studio surface — 182 deterministic transforms, 9 named recipes, keyless free tier, x402 USDC on Base for paid routes, public proposal registry. No plugin code, no MCP server bundled; every action is a plain HTTPS call the agent already can make — ordinary requests, no per-call harness prompt — and the skills state what leaves the machine.
